title: What you can’t miss in ‘26 at EAA AirVenture Oshkosh
summary: Whether it's your first visit or continuing a long-standing tradition, here’s what you won’t want to miss at EAA AirVenture Oshkosh 2026:
body_markdown:
The Garmin Pilot team has been hard at work rolling out major updates throughout 2026.


See the latest features, including how to make planning your next flight easier with the new Flights page, daily weather forecasts, airport and FBO comments, SmartCharts for Canada and Mexico and more. Garmin Pilot also makes flying into Oshkosh easier than ever with the FISK Arrival being part of Garmin SmartCharts arrival procedures and navigation database.


Also, see the painted dots and squares on the Oshkosh runways with their depiction on our SmartCharts airport diagram for the Oshkosh Wittman Regional Airport (KOSH).
